This is the **instructor-only** home for *Statistical Inference via Data Science: A ModernDive into R and the Tidyverse* (2nd ed.). Every resource below is generated automatically from the book's chapter content, so things stay in sync as the book evolves.

::: {.callout-tip title="New to ModernDive? Start here →"}
**5-step path to your first class:**

1. **Look at the [sample syllabus](syllabus.html)** — see how a 15-week term maps to the 11 chapters.
2. **Check the [pacing calculator](pacing-calculator.html)** — plug in your weeks/minutes; get a chapter-by-week schedule that fits.
3. **Set up a [Posit Cloud workspace](posit-cloud.html)** — students click your link, no install pain, week 1 goes smoothly.
4. **Open the [lesson plan for Chapter 1](lesson-plans.html)** — see what to teach, what to skip, how long it'll take.
5. **Use the [search button](#) in the top right** any time you need to find something — it covers every page in this hub.
:::

This site is password-protected. The same `INSTRUCTOR_PASSWORD` unlocks every page in this hub (you'll only be prompted once per browser session — tick "Remember me" to skip the prompt for 30 days). If you don't have the password, contact the authors via [moderndive.com](https://moderndive.com/about.html).
:::

## About this site

::: {.callout-note title="How it builds"}
The whole hub is one Quarto project (`instructor-solutions/`) plus a dozen standalone HTML reports generated by R scripts in `scripts/`. The companion private repo [`moderndive_exercise_solutions`](https://github.com/moderndive/moderndive_exercise_solutions) renders this project in CI, builds a [Pagefind](https://pagefind.app/) sitewide search index over every rendered page, [staticrypt](https://github.com/robinmoisson/staticrypt)s the HTML with the shared `INSTRUCTOR_PASSWORD`, and deploys to its gh-pages branch (which Netlify serves at this URL).
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="To regenerate any artifact locally"}
From the book repo root:

```bash
Rscript scripts/build_syllabus.R
Rscript scripts/build_lesson_plans.R
Rscript scripts/build_homework_planner.R
Rscript scripts/build_slide_decks.R
Rscript scripts/build_facilitator_notes.R
Rscript scripts/exercise_coverage_map.R
Rscript scripts/build_concept_map.R
Rscript scripts/build_assessment_matrix.R
Rscript scripts/build_misconceptions.R
Rscript scripts/build_exam_bank.R          # also writes LMS exports
Rscript scripts/build_pacing_calculator.R
Rscript scripts/build_cumulative_review.R
Rscript scripts/build_flashcards.R         # Anki/Quizlet decks from glossary
quarto render instructor-solutions          # renders rubrics, projects, ta-guide, common-errors, etc.
```

All output is gitignored (`instructor-solutions/_site/`). The search index requires `npx pagefind --site instructor-solutions/_site` after everything else; not needed for local dev unless you want to test search.
:::
